method: Read-only comparison with training_base_audit/audit_cmo3.py plus direct numeric comparison of keyform point arrays. Neither CMO3 was modified.

hair_ahoge_artmesh_Param.note: The former ArtMesh forms were a no-op. The new direct ArtMesh contribution exists only at -1; +1 still equals the neutral ArtMesh form.

physics_unchanged: Side hair: ParamAngleZ -> ParamHairSide, output angleScale 5.0, particle radius 8.0
Back hair: ParamAngleZ -> ParamHairBack, output angleScale 4.5, particle radius 10.0

additional_form_changes_outside_the_stat.assessment: Real neutral geometry change, not serialization noise. Confirm it was intentional.

additional_form_changes_outside_the_stat.unchanged_rows: All six forms at Param=-1 and Param=+1
additional_form_changes_outside_the_stat.assessment: Only the Param=0 row changed. This makes front-hair endpoint shapes depend on the ahoge parameter as it leaves zero; confirm this coupling was intended.
Symmetric real endpoint increase of about 5x versus the prior 0.00578 excursion. Confirm it was intentional.

numeric_risks: Ahoge +1 parent-warp excursion is 0.33524 versus 0.11753 at -1, while the direct ArtMesh adds 0.11174 only at -1. The two sides are intentionally or accidentally asymmetric and must be judged visually.
Both hair_ahoge and its parent Hair_ahoge_wrap are driven by Param, so the -1 result stacks direct-mesh and parent-warp deformation.
Hair_ahoge_wrap neutral moved by 0.00482 maximum from Ren_base; this is small but changes the default pose.
The strengthened Side endpoints remain balanced across the mirrored strong directions: L +1 max 0.06228 and R -1 max 0.06531. Their opposite endpoints remain near 0.0161.

Parent-reported Physics preview peaked at 114.277% for Side during abrupt full reversal, 14.277 percentage points above the nominal 100% endpoint. This can cause endpoint clamping or a short flat spot even though the reported visual check found no hole. Ahoge peak 52.518% remained inside the nominal range.
conclusion: The requested ahoge, Side endpoint, and front/ahoge physics changes are present and all routing, hierarchy, topology, clipping, images, counts, and atlas-free status are preserved. No definite structural corruption was found. Three additional real form changes need intent confirmation: hair_front_C neutral geometry, the Param=0 row of HairFrontC_Warp, and both Hair_Back_Sway endpoints.
